status: overlap risk screening, not reference training or proof of independence
roundabout: 40 is conditional and not an entire-class mapping
track_exclusion_policy: Any accepted potential training overlap excludes every available image of the full class/track key
crop_policy: Official full image and inclusive ROI crop versus Indian full image and every labeled box crop, independently stretched to 64x64
limitations: Perceptual screening is exhaustive under its hash gates, not exhaustive geometric matching
Generic sign designs can produce false positives; exclusions are conservative potential overlaps
Crops, JPEG compression, viewpoint changes and unknown upstream provenance can cause misses
Final GTSRB test files lack original training-track identifiers; no invented track assignment
